title: CDIF Manifest profile
description: Marked by schema:hasPart in either of the two places the profile declares it: on a schema:distribution item, listing the member files of an archive that have no address of their own (profile section 3.5); or on the schema:Dataset itself, listing package members that are independently accessible at their own addresses (sections 3.1/3.2). The Dataset-level form was not detected until 2026-09-05 -- it did not exist in CDIF until 2026-08-06 and this rule predated it, so records using resourcePartArray used the profile without ever declaring it. Constrained to a schema:Dataset subject on purpose: schema:hasPart also means instrument sub-components and workflow sub-workflows, and ?d is unbound when this ASK runs. The cdifArchiveDistribution block has no content rules.shacl yet, so this is presence-only.
